column1: CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.F2009_sp_del_Kho @Auto_ID BIGINT, @Last_Updated_By NVARCHAR(100)=NULL, @Last_Updated_By_Function NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
/* Warehouse/product identity changes can alter future scope
derivation.  Treat all master deletes as root-exclusive
maintenance, even when the selected entity is not inventory data. */
UPDATE dbo.tbl_DM_Kho SET deleted=1, Last_Updated=SYSUTCDATETIME(), Last_Updated_By=@Last_Updated_By, Last_Updated_By_Function=@Last_Updated_By_Function WHERE Auto_ID=@Auto_ID
IF @Ten_Kho=N'' THROW 51040,N'Tên kho không được để trống.',1
